findings.message: 6 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Full notes at ogimg.in/changelog" above "Release 2.4"; "The Off Hours" above "Cutting our image build to nothing"; "The editor" above "Granular control, start to finish"; "Type controls" above "Ag"; "Preview simulator" above "Check the card where it will land"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: Geist Mono — e.g. "33 layouts in the gallery", "01", "02", "03"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.
Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 7 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "33 layouts in the gallery", "The editor", "Geist Sans, Manrope, Sora, Lora", "Templates → layers → export").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 10 gradient fill(s): div#og-template-node.relative.isolate → linear-gradient(155deg, rgb(11, 11, 13) 0%, rgb(28, 28, 32) 100%) | div#og-template-node.relative.isolate → linear-gradient(160deg, rgb(244, 244, 245) 0%, rgb(228, 228, 231) 100%) | div#og-template-node.relative.isolate → linear-gradient(165deg, rgb(17, 19, 24) 0%, rgb(26, 29, 36) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 2 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.order-1.hidden → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | div.og-canvas.relative → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 31 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): section.relative.overflow-hidden 1440px | section.scroll-mt-20.border-b 1440px | div.overflow-hidden.border-b 427px | div.overflow-hidden.border-b 427px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.

findings.message: 5 typefaces in use (Geist Sans, Geist Mono, Geist Pixel Square, Space Grotesk, Sora).
findings.fix: Two at most: one display, one text. Often one is enough.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 13px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.
